implementation.path: Actual Opus packets -> continuous AudioDecoder -> MediaStreamTrackGenerator -> native WebAudio destination -> native relay -> same no-PLC receiver -> owned Teams sender
implementation.missing_media: Native WebAudio zero underflow, not extrapolated speech. No packets are forwarded into the owned native NetEq decoder.
implementation.backpressure: One RFC6716 Opus packet admitted through decode/output/write at a time; AudioData closed after write. No answer-length, total-byte, or total-duration quota.
implementation.completion: Require independently observed actual source quiet and rendered quiet; underflow zeros cannot satisfy source quiet.
implementation.codec: Negotiate supported Opus48k; validate actual payload codec; retain continuous decoder state.
implementation.timestamp: Unwrap 32-bit RTP timestamp; do not replay duplicate/backward frames.

prototype.path: AudioDecoder -> MediaStreamTrackGenerator -> createMediaStreamSource -> createMediaStreamDestination -> native sender. No rendering AudioWorklet; worklets used only as zero-gain scalar meters.
prototype.verdict: PASS for measured packet-starvation case: exact zero gap, old-tone extrapolation absent, continuous RTP and stable sender track, distinct after-gap tone restored.
limitations: No reordering, duplicate, drift, burst-overload, or wrap test. No general NetEq replacement claim.

Async decoder output callbacks are not awaited by WebCodecs. Writer promise resolution is not playback pacing; JS cap8 for pending writes plus separate decodeQueue cap8 do not establish internal browser queue bounds. Production should bound total admitted decode/write work and release each slot only on completed write/closed AudioData.
Decoded-media counters above exclude continuous WebAudio underflow zeros; RTP baseline counters are not bypass-path delivery evidence.
Close checked for all owned peers/tracks/context/decoder. Explicit reader cancel/writer close/AudioData closes are in probe source. Production ownership/A isolation not tested.

resolved_validation_failures: Owned sender policy migrated from raw receiver track identity to exact receiver -> no-PLC decoder -> rendered track -> sender identity.
Per-packet AudioDecoder.flush degraded tone and was replaced with continuous decoder and packet-output rendezvous.

Initial regression runs timed out on unsupported API setup in insecure fixtures. Validate APIs before stream acquisition; initialize target decoder after setRemoteDescription settles, before publishing answer, so failure does not close the peer inside its ontrack negotiation callback. Added early-failure cleanup regression.
limits: Not a real GPT Live or Teams listening test.
Remote Teams may still perform PLC; existing buffered true audio is not erased.
No NetEq reordering/time stretching; late/backward packets are not replayed.
Browser main-thread stalls and late/missing input may now be audible silence; no promise of improved smoothness or word completeness.
No new application jitter-buffer target setting; jitterBufferTarget does not control this bypass path.
